title: Trade-In Agreements Title-Delay Chargeback: Accounting Method
content:
**Method.** On a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement, the title-delay chargeback is the grade's title delay chargeback percentage of the value credited, the value credited being the total of the agreement's value-credited entries; it is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Value credited | The total of the value-credited entries on the agreement's history |
| Percentage | The grade's title delay chargeback percentage for the agreement's condition grade |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Value credited | Hypothetical percentage | Chargeback |
|---|---|---|
| $9875.00 | 100 percent | $9875.00 |
| $9875.00 | 60 percent | $5925.00 |
| $12333.33 | 30 percent | $3700.00 (from $3699.999, rounded to the nearest cent) |
